value.rationale: The new local classification refines a distinguished degree-eleven normal ACM multisecant fourfold from set-theoretic singular-plane data to a uniform complete transverse analytic ring. It distinguishes the stratum from an ordinary double point, determines its multiplicity and canonical Cartier index, and detects a noncanonical locus with explicit discrepancy. These are natural geometric invariants not implied by the previously reported decomposition.
